newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Canberra says budget not only issue for jobs.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Canberra says budget not only issue for jobs.

text.p: Australian Industrial Relations Minister Peter Reith said on Tuesday successful passage of the government's budget and labour reform package through the upper house Senate would not automatically translate into more jobs.

"The job is not over with the budget and industrial relations reforms," Reith told Australian Broadcasting Corp radio. "But obviously we think they are very important to set the scene for a better employment record in the future."
Reith also said he believed the government's new employment committee would help to boost the employment situation.
"I think it can do a lot," he said. "It can focus government policy on those changes which will help improve the situation."
Prime Minister John Howard announced on Monday the formation of the Cabinet committee to ensure that all policies affecting employment remained consistent.

"We've got a lot of things on the go which are all directed at improving Australia's employment situation, but to have a high powered economic committee, a sub committee of Cabinet, focussed on the issues, meeting on a regular basis, taking advice, and looking at the issues from every angle, I think is a very sensible and welcome move," Reith said.
